title: How To Contact The Voyager 2 Probe (PART 1)
summary: Dave Jones of EEVblog and Richard Stephenson tour the 70m DSS43 dish at the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex and explain how NASA talks to Voyager 2. It covers the transmitters, receivers and tracking involved.
why: Recommended in Voyager threads as the best look at how operators actually contact the probe.

quote.text: Dave Jones of EEVBlog has a nice series of videos talking to Richard Stephenson, Operations Supervisor at the DSN's Canberra site.
